from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as reported in the financial document")
    liability_total: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of 'Total Liabilities' (负债合计) from the balance sheet")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit associated with the financial figures, e.g., '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The text label for the reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The specific end date of the reporting period, e.g., '2024-03-31'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liability_records: list[CompanyLiabilityRecord]
